name: Turbulent Sunburst
description: A molten, heat-shimmered sunburst of color rays, warped by a turbulence filter and slowly rotating around the plate's center.

code.style: --rule: ( @place-cell: center; @size: 140% calc(${width} * 6 / @size); background: @pd(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); transform-origin: 1% center; transform: translateX(50%) rotate(calc(@i * 360deg / @size)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; position: relative; transform: scale(1.4); transform-origin: center; filter: @svg-filter(<svg><filter x="-70%" y="-70%" width="240%" height="240%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".08" numOctaves="3" /><feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" scale="170" /></filter></svg>); box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); }
